purpose: Component diagnosis: remove visual coordinate ambiguity, then vary only training integrator
initialization: Same original initial_params.p for both arms; no previous learned dynamics reused
optimizer: Original Adam grouping, dynamics lr=6e-5, element clip 5; optimizer state retained
input: True B,C,midpoint Cartesian positions and exact velocities, normalized by original calibration; actions unchanged
loss: Original four-step dynamics loss component and its 43 windows; reconstruction and heatmap losses removed with the visual modules
velocity: Exact simulator velocity, projected to the given velocity constraint for both arms
changed_factor_between_arms: Original Euler versus RK4 with 4 substeps per image interval inside the training loss
evaluation: Exact state at the middle context timestamp; original odeint, 50 timestamps; physical position and independent crank-force acceleration errors
checkpoint_selection: Final epoch 40, no test-guided selection or early stop
limitations: This supervised state-input control is not the paper's video-only method and cannot replace its published comparison.
It diagnoses learning capacity and optimization in physical coordinates; it is not a matched open-chain topology control.
Only one paired seed; equal update/data budget, different solver computation cost, reported separately.
The old held-out split is used for exploratory diagnosis, not a new confirmatory benchmark after tuning.
